# Philip Ozouf Jr

Philip Ozouf Jr is the current Deputy of [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 1999.

Philip Ozouf Jr has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr#e2)

  Elected as Senator with 68.6% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr#e10)

  Elected as Senator with 35.8% of the ballot.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/philip-ozouf.html)
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 40.4% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/philip-ozouf-2/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20150407031903/http://ozouf.je/manifesto/philipozouf-manifesto2014-finalwebs.pdf)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g2AhYNzWz_g)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-ozouf-jr#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 7 with 30.4% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/philip-ozouf/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-Hp1jh7Sc0)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=38)
